board.title: Delivery board
board.subtitle: Bags to collect from the kiosks and take to customers
board.nothingInHandMessage: Pick up a task alongside to get started.
board.noOpenRequestsMessage: New requests from the kiosks appear here automatically.
board.headToKiosk: Head to the kiosk and request the bags.
board.completedSubtitle: Everything you have closed, newest first

task.title: Delivery
task.notMine: Another courier has already picked this task up. You can see where it stands, but only they can move it.
task.openToEveryone: This task is open to every courier on this site. Claim it and it becomes yours alone.
task.agentWillCheck: The agent will check this task is assigned to you before opening anything.
task.showThemYourName: Show them your name. Once they confirm you are the assigned courier, the compartment code appears here.
task.expired: Expired. Ask the agent at the kiosk to approve again — they will give you a new code.
task.scanPlaceholder: Scan or type a bag barcode
task.demoScanner: Demo mode — these buttons stand in for a handheld scanner.
task.carrying: You are carrying {{count}} bag(s). Hand them to the customer at the address above, then close the task.
task.failPlaceholder: Customer not at the address, refused the delivery, wrong address…
task.auditNote: This is written to the audit trail and shown to the kiosk.

kiosk.title: Deliveries
kiosk.subtitle: Courier jobs raised at this station
kiosk.emptyMessage: Open a delivery from a stored booking and it appears here.
kiosk.checkPerson: Check the person in front of you before anything opens.
kiosk.noCourier: No courier is assigned — do not release anything.
kiosk.codeHint: Read it off the kiosk. The courier sees it for 15 minutes, then it dies.

request.title: Send these bags to the customer
request.addressPlaceholder: Hotel, room number, gate — anything the courier can find
request.addressHint: Where the courier is taking the bags.
request.notesHint: Access instructions, who to ask for, timing.
request.proofSpent: The proof is recorded on the booking and will be spent on this delivery.
request.codeGoesTo: A code goes to the phone or email recorded on the booking — never to a number read out on the call.
request.verifyToEnable: Verify the customer to enable the button

ASSIGNED.label: Assigned

RELEASE_REQUESTED.label: Awaiting the agent
RELEASE_REQUESTED.hint: The kiosk agent is confirming who you are

RELEASE_APPROVED.label: Compartment open
RELEASE_APPROVED.hint: Open the compartment and scan every bag

PICKED_UP.label: In transit
PICKED_UP.hint: Deliver to the address on the job

CANCELLED.label: Cancelled
CANCELLED.hint: Called off before the bags moved
